name: India
line: India was the eastern edge of King Xerxes' huge Persian kingdom, the far end of his 127 provinces, which stretched from India to Cush.

moments.title: The edge of Xerxes' kingdom
moments.text: The book of Esther begins by saying that Xerxes ruled 127 provinces from India to Cush. India is named as one end of his huge kingdom.

moments.title: Mordecai's orders go out
moments.text: Mordecai's orders for the Jews went to all 127 provinces from India to Cush. Each province got them in its own script and language.
